availableCommands.name: debug
availableCommands.description: Debug your current Claude Code session by reading the session debug log. (bundled)

availableCommands.name: audit
availableCommands.description: Comprehensive codebase audit for release readiness. Parallel exploration of docs, code, config, tests, and specs to identify cruft, then interactive triage with clear action options. (project)

availableCommands.name: codex
availableCommands.description: Use when the user asks to run Codex CLI (codex exec, codex resume) or wants Codex to review PRs, plans, or specs. Delegates to GPT-5.3-codex with preset reasoning modes. (project)

availableCommands.name: e2e
availableCommands.description: E2E testing patterns for kspec web UI. Use when writing Playwright tests, debugging hydration issues, or working with daemon fixtures. (project)

availableCommands.name: eval-agents
availableCommands.description: Evaluate whether AGENTS.md provides enough context for agents to make correct decisions. Spawns test agents with scenario questions and grades responses. (project)

availableCommands.name: local-review
availableCommands.description: Pre-PR quality review - verify AC coverage, test quality, E2E preference, and test isolation. (project)

availableCommands.name: pr
availableCommands.description: Create a pull request from current work. Handles branch creation, commits, push, and PR creation. Detects branch protection and guides through the PR workflow. (project)

availableCommands.name: pr-review
availableCommands.description: Review a PR linked to a kspec task, post findings as inline comments, and merge only when all quality gates pass. You NEVER fix code — you review and comment. If issues found, kick back to worker. (project)

availableCommands.name: release
availableCommands.description: Create versioned releases - bump version via PR, tag, create GitHub release. CI publishes to npm. (project)

availableCommands.name: svelte-5
availableCommands.description: Svelte 5 patterns, gotchas, and solutions. Use when working with Svelte 5/SvelteKit, especially for reactivity, SSR, and state management issues. (project)

availableCommands.name: create-workflow
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Formalize repeatable patterns into trackable kspec workflows. Design steps, choose triggers, create loop variants, and integrate with skills.

availableCommands.name: help
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Get help with kspec commands and workflows

availableCommands.name: observe
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Capture and act on systemic patterns — friction, successes, questions, and ideas. The feedback loop that drives process improvement.

availableCommands.name: plan
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Translate approved plans into specs and tasks. Import structured documents or create incrementally. Plans persist as durable artifacts with audit trail.

availableCommands.name: reflect
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Structured reflection at the end of work sessions. Identifies learnings, friction points, and improvements for system evolution.

availableCommands.name: review
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Kspec-specific review gates — spec alignment, own AC coverage, trait AC coverage, and validation integration. Building block for project-specific review workflows.

availableCommands.name: task-work
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Structured task lifecycle — start, work, note, submit, complete. Fix cycle handling, scope management, loop mode for automation, and quality gates.

availableCommands.name: triage
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Triage inbox items systematically. Records decisions with audit trail, then executes actions. Supports inbox, observations, and automation eligibility triage.

availableCommands.name: triage-automation
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Assess and prepare tasks for automation eligibility. Verify spec coverage, acceptance criteria, and task readiness for automated agents.

availableCommands.name: triage-inbox
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Process inbox items using the record-act pattern. Categorize, promote to spec/task, merge duplicates, defer, or delete stale items with full audit trail.

availableCommands.name: writing-specs
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Create and maintain specification items — modules, features, requirements, acceptance criteria, and traits. The source of truth for what to build.

availableCommands.description: Clear conversation history but keep a summary in context. Optional: /compact [instructions for summarization]

<!--
  AC: @ui-dashboard-overview ac-1 — Dashboard home view
  Active work section, status summary, needs-attention aggregation.
-->
<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
	import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
	import { base } from '$app/paths';
	import {
		fetchTasks,
		fetchInbox,
		fetchObservations,
		fetchValidation,
		fetchAgentStatus,
		type AgentDispatchStatus,
		type ActiveInvocation
	} from '$lib/api';
	import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '$lib/components/ui/card';
	import { Badge } from '$lib/components/ui/badge';
	import { Skeleton } from '$lib/components/ui/skeleton';
	import { getProjectVersion } from '$lib/stores/project.svelte';
	import { subscribe, unsubscribe, on, off } from '$lib/stores/connection.svelte';
	import { isStaticMode } from '$lib/stores/mode.svelte';
	import AlertTriangle from '@lucide/svelte/icons/triangle-alert';
	import InboxIcon from '@lucide/svelte/icons/inbox';
	import Eye from '@lucide/svelte/icons/eye';
	import ShieldAlert from '@lucide/svelte/icons/shield-alert';
	import Ban from '@lucide/svelte/icons/ban';
	import Activity from '@lucide/svelte/icons/activity';
	import Bot from '@lucide/svelte/icons/bot';
	import ExternalLink from '@lucide/svelte/icons/external-link';

	// --- State ---
	let loading = $state(true);
	let error = $state<string | null>(null);

	// Task counts
	interface TaskCounts {
		ready: number;
		in_progress: number;
		needs_work: number;
		pending_review: number;
		blocked: number;
		completed: number;
		cancelled: number;
	}

	let counts = $state<TaskCounts>({
		ready: 0,
		in_progress: 0,

<script lang="ts">
	// AC: @web-dashboard ac-4, ac-5, ac-9, ac-10, ac-33
	// AC: @multi-directory-daemon ac-27 - Reload on project change
	// AC: @gh-pages-export ac-16 - Disable Start Task in static mode
	import { page } from '$app/stores';
	import { base } from '$app/paths';
	import { onMount, onDestroy, flushSync } from 'svelte';
	import type { TaskSummary, TaskDetail, BroadcastEvent } from '@kynetic-ai/shared';
	import TaskFilters from '$lib/components/TaskFilters.svelte';
	import TaskList from '$lib/components/TaskList.svelte';
	import { fetchTasks, fetchTask, startTask, addTaskNote } from '$lib/api';
	import { subscribe, unsubscribe, on, off } from '$lib/stores/connection.svelte';
	import { isStaticMode, ReadOnlyModeError } from '$lib/stores/mode.svelte';
	import { Button } from '$lib/components/ui/button';
	import { Badge } from '$lib/components/ui/badge';
	import { Textarea } from '$lib/components/ui/textarea';
	import { Separator } from '$lib/components/ui/separator';
	import * as Tooltip from '$lib/components/ui/tooltip';
	import XIcon from '@lucide/svelte/icons/x';
	import LayoutGrid from '@lucide/svelte/icons/layout-grid';
	import ListIcon from '@lucide/svelte/icons/list';
	import { getProjectVersion } from '$lib/stores/project.svelte';

	let tasks = $state<TaskSummary[]>([]);
	let total = $state(0);
	let loading = $state(true);
	let error = $state('');
	let updatedTaskIds = $state<Set<string>>(new Set());

	// Use $state with an object for panel state to ensure deep reactivity
	let panel = $state<{ open: boolean; task: TaskDetail | null }>({
		open: false,
		task: null
	});

	let noteContent = $state('');
	let isSubmitting = $state(false);
	let panelError = $state('');

	// Reactive: re-fetch when URL params change
	let filterParams = $derived({
		status: $page.url.searchParams.get('status') || undefined,
		type: $page.url.searchParams.get('type') || undefined,
		tag: $page.url.searchParams.get('tag') || undefined,
		assignee: $page.url.searchParams.get('assignee') || undefined,
		automation: $page.url.searchParams.get('automation') || undefined,
		plan: $page.url.searchParams.get('plan') || undefined,
		limit: 50,
		offset: 0
	});

	// Track the last processed ref to avoid infinite loops
	let lastProcessedRef = $state('');

	$effect(() => {
		// Re-fetch when filterParams changes - explicitly access all properties for dependency tracking
		const { status, type, tag, assignee, automation, plan, limit, offset } = filterParams;
		loadTasks();
	});

	// AC: @multi-directory-daemon ac-27 - Reload data when project changes
	$effect(() => {
		const version = getProjectVersion();
		if (version > 0) {
			// Only reload if version has been incremented (not on initial load)
			loadTasks();
		}
	});

	// AC: Open task detail when URL has ref param
	$effect(() => {
		const urlRef = $page.url.searchParams.get('ref');
		if (urlRef && urlRef !== lastProcessedRef) {
			lastProcessedRef = urlRef;
			handleSelectTask(urlRef);
		}
	});

	async function loadTasks() {
		loading = true;
		error = '';

		try {
			const response = await fetchTasks(filterParams);
			tasks = response.items;
			total = response.total;
		} catch (err) {
			error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load tasks';
			console.error('Error loading tasks:', err);
		} finally {
			loading = false;
		}
	}

	async function handleSelectTask(taskId: string) {
		console.log('[TasksPage] handleSelectTask called for:', taskId);
		try {
			console.log('[TasksPage] Fetching task details...');
			const task = await fetchTask(taskId);
			console.log('[TasksPage] Task fetched:', task?.title);

Perfect! Now I have enough information. Let me create a comprehensive summary: ## Codebase Exploration Report: Task & Item Reference Handling ### Overview This is a read-only exploration of the **kynetic-spec-ui** web application, which is a SvelteKit 5-based UI for managing project specifications and tasks. The codebase heavily uses references (task refs, spec/item refs) throughout the UI for navigation and linking. --- ## 1. Architectural Context ### Recent Work (Current Branch) - **Branch**: `fix/double-at-task-ref` - **Recent Commit** (129d87ee2): Fixed double `@@` on task ref display in SessionContextPanel and made task refs clickable links - Normalized task_id by stripping leading `@` before display - Made task reference clickable with `` - Added task title resolution via `fetchTask()` ### Key Structural Files - **Design System**: `/packages/web-ui/src/lib/ds/tokens.css` (OKLCH color space, status tokens, semantic colors) - **API Client**: `/packages/web-ui/src/lib/api.ts` (main API interaction layer) - **Type Definitions**: `/packages/shared/src/api.ts` (shared REST API contract types) --- ## 2. Component Structure (125 Svelte components, 148 total files) ### Top-Level Components (Root level) - **ItemDetail.svelte** (238 lines) — displays spec/item details in a sheet panel with AC checklist - **TaskList.svelte** (144 lines) — table view of tasks with status/priority/spec ref - **TaskFilters.svelte** — task filtering UI - **Sidebar.svelte** — main navigation and tree structure - **ItemTree.svelte** — hierarchical item/spec browsing - **MobileNav.svelte** — responsive mobile navigation - **CommandPalette.svelte** — command search/navigate - **ConnectionStatus.svelte**, **ReadOnlyBanner.svelte**, **ProjectSelector.svelte** ### Board Components (Kanban/Task Management) - **TaskCard.svelte** (129 lines) — individual task card with priority, tags, spec_ref link - **TaskDetailModal.svelte** — expanded task detail in modal - **BoardColumn.svelte** — Kanban column container - **ActiveFleetRow.svelte** — agent/invocation status rows - **board-utils.ts** (208 lines) — column distribution logic, status color mapping, VCS ref parsing ### Session Components (Live session viewing) - **SessionContextPanel.svelte** (266 lines) — right panel showing session metadata with task ref link and spec context - **SessionStream.svelte** (4,662 bytes) — event stream visualization - **ToolCallView.svelte** — tool call/result display - **MessageBlock.svelte**, **SystemBlock.svelte**, **ThinkingBlock.svelte** — event type renderers - **session-utils.ts** (14,951 bytes) — event parsing, tool icon mapping, timeline formatting ### UI Component Library (22 subdirectories) Shadcn-based primitives: - accordion, badge, button, card, command - data-table, dialog, input, select - separator, sheet, sidebar, skeleton - table, tabs, textarea, tooltip --- ## 3. Reference Handling Patterns ### Current Reference Display Patterns #### Pattern 1: Task Reference Display (TaskList.svelte, lines 113-124) ```svelte {#if task.spec_ref} e.stopPropagation()}> {task.spec_ref} {:else} — {/if} ``` #### Pattern 2: Task Card Spec Ref (TaskCard.svelte, lines 94-103) ```svelte {#if task.spec_ref}
e.stopPropagation()} data-testid="spec-ref-link"> @{task.spec_ref}
{/if} ``` #### Pattern 3: Session Task Reference (SessionContextPanel.svelte, lines 110-132) **Current Implementation** (after fix commit 129d87ee2): ```svelte {#if session.task_id} {@const rawId = normalizeTaskId(session.task_id)}
{#if taskTitle} {taskTitle} {:else} @{rawId.slice(0, 8)} {/if}
{/if} ``` #### Pattern 4: Spec Context Display (SessionContextPanel.svelte, lines 122-130) ```svelte {#if session.spec_context}

Spec Context

{session.spec_context.spec_ref}

{session.spec_context.title}

{/if} ``` #### Pattern 5: Item Traits (ItemDetail.svelte, lines 184-204) ```svelte {#each item.traits as trait} {/each} ``` #### Pattern 6: Linked Tasks in Item Detail (ItemDetail.svelte, lines 208-227) ```svelte {#each linkedTasks as task} {formatStatus(task.status)} {task.title} {#if task.notes_count > 0} {task.notes_count} notes {/if} {/each} ``` --- ## 4. Data Types & Contracts ### SessionDetail (web-ui/src/lib/api.ts) ```typescript export interface SessionDetail extends SessionSummary { task_id?: string; // Reference to task being worked on agent_id?: string; trigger?: string; spec_context?: SessionSpecContext | null; // Resolved spec details budget?: SessionBudget | null; } ``` ### SessionSpecContext ```typescript export interface SessionSpecContext { spec_ref: string; // The @reference title: string; // Full title acceptance_criteria: Array<{ id: string; // e.g., "ac-1" description: string; // AC text }>; } ``` ### TaskSummary (shared/src/api.ts) ```typescript export interface TaskSummary { _ulid: string; slugs: string[]; title: string; type: string; status: string; priority: number; spec_ref?: string; // Reference to spec item tags: string[]; depends_on: string[]; automation?: string; created_at: string; started_at?: string; notes_count: number; } ``` ### ItemDetail (shared/src/api.ts) ```typescript export interface ItemDetail extends ItemSummary { description?: string; acceptance_criteria: AcceptanceCriterion[]; traits: string[]; // List of @trait-refs depends_on: string[]; priority?: number; } ``` --- ## 5. Routing Structure ### Routes Available - `/` — main dashboard - `/tasks` — task list view (main view for task management) - `/tasks/board` — Kanban board view - `/items` — spec/item list and detail - `/specs` — spec list view - `/agents` — agent management - `/inbox` — inbox items - `/observations` — system observations/friction log - `/plans` — project plans - `/sessions` — session history - `/sessions/[id]` — session detail view - `/settings` — preferences - `/workflows` — workflow definitions - `/validate` — validation dashboard - `/triage` — triage queue ### Detail Navigation Pattern All detail views use query parameters: ``` ?ref={encodeURIComponent(refId)} ``` Examples: - `/tasks?ref=01KK2NNMYXCBD0MMWKJS4MCGRQ` - `/items?ref=@my-spec-item` - `/sessions/abc123` — session ID in path --- ## 6. Reference Normalization Issues & Solutions ### Issue: Double @@ in Display **Problem**: When `task_id` or `spec_ref` contains a leading `@`, displaying as `@{ref}` results in `@@prefix`. **Solution** (commit 129d87ee2): ```typescript function normalizeTaskId(taskId: string): string { return taskId.replace(/^@/, ''); } ``` Applied in: - SessionContextPanel (task_id display) - sessions/+page.svelte (shortTaskRef function) ### Current Implementation Gaps 1. **Spec context spec_ref** — plain text span, not clickable (line 128, SessionContextPanel) - Should be made clickable like task references 2. **No consistent reference parser** — multiple inline patterns across components - Traits use conditional slice; task refs use `encodeURIComponent()` - No shared utility for ref normalization --- ## 7. API Endpoints & Query Patterns ### Fetch Functions - `fetchTask(ref)` — get single task by ULID or slug - `fetchItem(ref)` — get single spec item by ULID or slug - `fetchTasks(params)` — list with filters (status, type, tag, automation, plan) - `fetchItems(params)` — list items with type, tag, plan filters - `fetchItemTasks(itemRef)` — get tasks linked to a spec item - `fetchSession(id)` — get session detail with spec_context and events ### Multi-Directory Support All API calls include `getProjectHeaders()`: ```typescript function getProjectHeaders(): HeadersInit { const path = getSelectedProjectPath(); return path ? { 'X-Kspec-Dir': path } : {}; } ``` --- ## 9. Design System & Styling ### Token File: tokens.css (160 lines) Provides CSS custom properties: - **Colors** (16): bg, fg, card, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, input, ring - **Status colors** (7): pending, in_progress, pending_review, needs_work, completed, blocked, cancelled - **Radii** (4): sm (0.25rem), md (0.375rem), lg (0.5rem), xl (0.75rem) - **Spacing** (7): xs–3xl (0.25rem to 4rem) - **Z-index layers** (7): base, dropdown, sticky, overlay, modal, popover, toast ### animations.css Custom animations (e.g., pulse for active session indicator) ### Color Mapping Pattern Components use Tailwind classes mapped to tokens: ```svelte class={`bg-status-${status} text-status-${status}-fg`} ``` --- ## 10. Critical Implementation Details ### AC Coverage Many components annotated with acceptance criteria references: - `ItemDetail.svelte`: ac-12, ac-13, ac-14, ac-15 (@web-dashboard spec) - `TaskList.svelte`: ac-4, ac-5, ac-33 - `TaskCard.svelte`: ac-2 (@ui-task-board spec) - `SessionContextPanel.svelte`: ac-4 (@ui-session-stream spec) ### Event Handling Pattern - Click handlers use `onclick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}` to prevent event bubbling on nested links - Svelte 5 uses new event dispatcher pattern with callbacks - TaskList supports both Svelte 4 (dispatch) and Svelte 5 (callback) patterns ### Static Mode Support - All API functions check `isStaticMode()` and use static data sources - Graceful no-op for write operations via `assertWritable()` - Supports GitHub Pages export use case --- ## 11. Key Files Summary Table | File | Lines | Purpose | |------|-------|---------| | TaskList.svelte | 144 | Task table with spec_ref links | | ItemDetail.svelte | 238 | Spec detail sheet panel with ACs | | TaskCard.svelte | 129 | Kanban card with spec_ref | | SessionContextPanel.svelte | 266 | Session sidebar with task/spec refs | | board-utils.ts | 208 | Status mapping, column logic, VCS parsing | | session-utils.ts | 14,951 | Event parsing, display blocks | | api.ts | 300+ | API client with ref-based fetch functions | | tokens.css | 160 | Design system tokens | --- ## 12. Directories Summary ### Component Directories ``` components/ ├── ui/ # 22 Shadcn primitives ├── board/ # Kanban: TaskCard, TaskDetailModal, BoardColumn, utils ├── session/ # Session: ContextPanel, Stream, utils ├── agents/ # Agent invocation views ├── ItemDetail.svelte # Spec detail panel ├── TaskList.svelte # Task table └── [7 other top-level] # Navigation, filters, tree, selectors ``` ### Route Pages ``` routes/ ├── +page.svelte # Dashboard ├── tasks/ # Task list & board ├── items/ # Item/spec list & detail ├── specs/ # Spec list ├── sessions/[id]/ # Session detail with stream ├── agents/, inbox/, plans/, workflows/, etc. ``` --- ## 13. Gaps & Opportunities for Enhancement 1. **Spec Context Ref Not Clickable** — SessionContextPanel line 128 should be an `` tag 2. **No Shared Reference Parser** — multiple inline patterns; create `lib/utils/reference.ts` 3. **Inconsistent Ref Display Format** — TaskCard uses `@{spec_ref}` but TaskList uses `{spec_ref}` 4. **No Reference Validation** — no type guard for ULID vs. slug format 5. **Missing Batch Reference Display** — no component for showing multiple refs (depends_on, context fields) 6. **Limited Ref Tooltips** — could add hover tooltips with full ref + type info 7. **No Ref Copy-to-Clipboard** — useful UX for terminal users 8. **Hardcoded Route Paths** — all navigation uses string literals; could centralize in route config --- ## Absolute File Paths Reference Key absolute paths for the codebase: ``` /home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/web-ui/src/lib/components/ItemDetail.svelte /home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/web-ui/src/lib/components/TaskList.svelte /home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/web-ui/src/lib/components/Sidebar.svelte /home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/web-ui/src/lib/components/board/TaskCard.svelte /home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/web-ui/src/lib/components/board/TaskDetailModal.svelte /home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/web-ui/src/lib/components/board/board-utils.ts /home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/web-ui/src/lib/components/session/SessionContextPanel.svelte /home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/web-ui/src/lib/components/session/session-utils.ts /home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/web-ui/src/lib/api.ts /home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/web-ui/src/lib/ds/tokens.css /home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/shared/src/api.ts /home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/web-ui/src/routes/tasks/+page.svelte /home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/web-ui/src/routes/sessions/[id]/+page.svelte ```
